usedFor: Zoho Calendar holds events, and HubSpot receives records through “Create Deal” and “Create Contact” when one is added.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new event is created in the selected calendar” in Zoho Calendar, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new calendar event, such as a booked meeting, can open a deal.

watchOut: “Create Contact” in HubSpot requires an email, so the event needs an attendee address to map.
